summary: The Gameweek 1–5 gap is points scored. Unused chips are not in it. The model played two chips on every squad, Bench Boost and Triple Captain. The 14 played 2.5 on average, so the model holds 0.5 more first-half chips. Second-half wallets cancel. Closing −27.43 with that half chip would need it to be worth 55 points. No such price is on file, so the gap stays −27.43.
